welcome.title: Welcome to PESKAS!
welcome.subtitle: This app helps you track your fishing trips and understand your fishing better.
welcome.keyMessage: The more you use this app, the more useful information you get to improve your fishing!

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.step1Desc: New users can register with username, country, vessel type, and password. Existing users can login with IMEI, boat name, or username
gettingStarted.step2Desc: Use your IMEI number, boat name, or username with your password to access the app
gettingStarted.step3Desc: Select English, Swahili, or Portuguese from the settings menu
gettingStarted.step4Desc: View your trips, report catches, check your stats, and manage your profile
gettingStarted.refreshDesc: Refresh the app regularly to ensure you have the latest features and improvements. Pull down to refresh or reload your browser.

viewTrips.title: View Your Fishing Trips
viewTrips.point1: See all your fishing trips on the map
viewTrips.point2: Different colors show your boat speed (slow, medium, fast)
viewTrips.point3: Click on any trip to see details
viewTrips.tip: Use the date picker to see trips from different time periods

reportCatch.title: Report Your Catches
reportCatch.whenDesc: Report after every fishing trip - even if you caught nothing
reportCatch.whatPoint3: OR select 'No Catch' if you caught nothing
reportCatch.photosDesc: Take photos of your catch. Photos help verify your catch and build trust.
reportCatch.whyDesc: Your reports create data that helps you see patterns and improve your fishing over time

myStats.title: See Your Progress
myStats.point1: View your total catches over time
myStats.point2: Compare your performance with other fishers in your community
myStats.point3: See which trips were most successful
myStats.point4: Learn which fishing methods work best for you
myStats.benefitDesc: Statistics help you understand what works and what doesn't in your fishing

liveLocation.title: Track Your Boat Now
liveLocation.point1: See where your boat is right now
liveLocation.point2: Useful for planning your next trip

profile.title: Manage Your Profile
profile.point1: Update your country, vessel type, and boat name
profile.point3: Change your password anytime for security

gpsLocation.title: My Current Location (GPS)
gpsLocation.desc: If you don't have a tracking device, you can still see your current location on the map
gpsLocation.point1: Click 'My Location' button on the map to get your current GPS coordinates
gpsLocation.point2: Your phone will ask permission to access location - allow it to see your position
gpsLocation.point3: Useful for marking fishing spots or sharing your location

bathymetry.title: Explore Ocean Depth
bathymetry.desc: View depth contours to understand the seabed and find better fishing spots
bathymetry.point1: Click the 'Bathymetry' button on the map to show depth lines
bathymetry.point2: Different colors show different depths (shallow to deep)
bathymetry.point3: Map is always visible even when you have no trips - explore bathymetry anytime
bathymetry.tipDesc: Different fish species prefer different depths. Understanding bathymetry helps you find the best fishing locations.

waypoints.title: Save Important Locations
waypoints.desc: Mark and save important fishing spots, ports, anchorages, and favorite locations for easy access later
waypoints.howToAddPoint1: Click the 'Waypoints' button on the map
waypoints.howToAddPoint2: Choose how to set coordinates: use your GPS, click on the map, or enter manually
waypoints.howToAddPoint3: Give it a name, select a type (port, fishing ground, etc.), and add an optional description
waypoints.howToAddPoint4: Save - your waypoint appears as a colored pin on the map
waypoints.typePort: Port - Blue pins for harbors and landing sites
waypoints.typeAnchorage: Anchorage - Green pins for safe anchoring spots
waypoints.typeFishing: Fishing Ground - Cyan pins for productive fishing areas
waypoints.typeFavorite: Favorite Spot - Orange pins for your personal favorites
waypoints.typeOther: Other - Gray pins for general locations
waypoints.managePoint1: Toggle visibility on/off with the switch next to each waypoint
waypoints.managePoint2: Click 'Show on Map' to center the map on any waypoint
waypoints.managePoint3: Delete waypoints you no longer need
waypoints.privacyDesc: All waypoints are completely private. Only you can see your saved locations - they are never shared with other users.

tips.title: Tips for Best Results
tips.tip1Desc: Even zero catch is important data. It helps you see the full picture.
tips.tip2Desc: Photos make your reports more reliable and help build trust in the data.
tips.tip3Desc: Look at your stats every week to see your progress and learn patterns.
tips.tip4Desc: See if you're improving over time by comparing different time periods.

understanding.title: Understanding Your Data
understanding.point1Desc: The more trips you report, the more accurate your statistics become.
understanding.point2Desc: Use the information to make better decisions about when and where to fish.
understanding.point3Desc: See how your fishing compares with others to learn what works.

profile.adminCap2: Access all fishing trips and statistics for selected vessels
profile.adminCap3: View catch reports and performance data across the system
